facts.summary: Phase 2 missed primary endpoint; no benefit seen, study likely stopped · Phase 2 · ATA188 in non-active progressive multiple sclerosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The study did not meet the primary endpoint of confirmed disability improvement (CDI) by expanded disability status scale (EDSS) at 12 months compared to placebo.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The study did not meet the primary endpoint of confirmed disability improvement (CDI) by expanded disability status scale (EDSS) at 12 months compared to placebo.
evidence.safety: Preliminary safety data showed there were no new safety signals in the EMBOLD study, reinforcing the favorable safety profile observed with ATA188 to date.
evidence.program_discontinued: however we anticipate stopping the study as no treatment benefit was observed.
